overview_description.description:
Knewton's mission is to personalize learning for the world.  Teachers, schools, and education companies around the world use Knewton to power digital course materials that dynamically adapt to each student’s unique needs. Knewton provides students with tailored recommendations for exactly what to study, teachers with analytics to better support each student, and publishers with content insights to develop more effective digital products.

Knewton was founded in 2008 and has offices in New York City, London, Tokyo, Singapore, and Dubai. 

Knewton has been recognized globally as a “Technology Pioneer” (World Economic Forum in Davos) and several times as one of the top 10 most innovative companies in education  (Fast Company).

about_short_description.short_description: Knewton is an adaptive learning technology provider with a mission to bring personalized education to the world.

product.name: Knewton Alta
product.description: An adaptive courseware providing personalized learning experiences, integrating practice with detailed answer explanations, just-in-time instruction, and remediation based on student performance.

product.name: Adaptive Learning Technology
product.description: Technology that personalizes learning by diagnosing students’ proficiency levels and adapting content accordingly in real-time.

product.name: Actionable Instructor Analytics
product.description: Dashboards for instructors offering data on student performance that is easy to review and navigate for actionable insights.

product.name: Integrated Learning Opportunities
product.description: Features that provide students with feedback, instruction, and remediation tailored to their individual needs to build mastery.

product.name: Accessibility Compliance
product.description: Ensures the technology, content, and user experience comply with WCAG 2.0 AA-level ADA standards, making learning accessible to all students.

product.name: Math Boosters
product.description: Integrated remediation of prerequisite mathematical skills foundational for success in subjects like General Chemistry and Statistics.
